dossier.scp_unleashed.205.title: Shadow Lamps
dossier.scp_unleashed.205.caption: SCP-205-1 during a day-shift test, aimed at the east wall of its cell.

page.title: Special Containment Procedures:
text: Both instances of SCP-205 are kept in a sealed cell with one bare wall. Each lamp is fed by its own direct line; outlets and extension leads are not to be used.

The cell is to stay dim apart from the lamps' own beams. No further fixtures may be installed, and the corridor lights outside are to be kept off while the lamps are lit. **All testing ends before nightfall.**

page.title: Description:
text: SCP-205 is a pair of vintage studio flood lamps on tall stands, each with a round reflector housing, a glass lens and hinged barn doors. They draw very little power and show no signs of age.

When a lit lamp is aimed at a wall close by, the shadow of a figure appears in its pool of light, although nobody stands in the beam. The figure holds still, waves, sits or reaches out. Each time the lamp flickers, the way old film does, the figure takes a new pose.
The figures do not acknowledge observers, and they have never left the wall during the day shift.

page.title: Addendum 205-1: Test Log
text: Test 205-03, 14:10: SCP-205-1 was aimed at the east wall. A standing figure appeared and waved. D-9113 waved back. No further effect.
Test 205-07, 19:40: the test overran its shift. %rThe figure on the wall was no longer human in shape.%r When D-9113 crossed the beam, the wall went empty.
Test 205-08: the corridor lights had been left on. %rD-9113 was recovered from the corridor with minor injuries.%r

page.title: Addendum 205-2: Provenance
page.text: Both lamps were recovered from a film studio that closed decades ago. They were handed to a reader of this file by the individual in Foundation dress described in the files of other objects. See field notes.

jei.scp_unleashed.info.scp205_lamp.1: SCP-205: a vintage studio flood lamp on a tall stand. Run a wire coil straight to the socket on its stand. It needs no outlet and draws a little power while lit.
jei.scp_unleashed.info.scp205_lamp.2: Use it with an empty hand to give it a quarter turn, or sneak and use it to tilt the head up or down. Its beam lights the way ahead for about ten blocks.
jei.scp_unleashed.info.scp205_lamp.3: Aimed at a wall close by, it throws the shadow of someone who is not there. The shadow moves whenever the lamp flickers. Researchers advise against standing in its light for long.
